item.hha_void.void_helmet.lore2: Set: Child of the Night — at night and in the End: invisibility, night vision, regeneration
item.hha_void.void_helmet.lore3: Set: Emergency Rift — below %s hearts: teleport away from everyone + full invis %ss (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_void.void_helmet.lore4: Set: Full Invis — invisibility (except at night) hides your armor too
item.hha_void.void_chestplate.lore2: Meteor Strike [%s] — homing meteors + void comet (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_void.void_chestplate.lore3: Set: Void Link — every hit arcs at 1/3 to 3/3 strength to the target's allies
item.hha_void.void_chestplate.lore4: Set: Void Collapse [%s] — drags every enemy within %s blocks in, flings them up and slams them down; you gain Strength + Invisibility (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_void.void_leggings.lore1: Void Pounce [%s] — teleport above the weakest creature within %s blocks + upward boost (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_void.void_leggings.lore2: Set: Shared Gifts — your positive effects arc to trusted players within %s blocks
item.hha_void.void_leggings.lore3: Set: The Void catches you — falling into the void teleports you to your spawn point instead of killing you
item.hha_void.void_boots.lore3: Void Step [2× %s] — teleport where you look, through walls (%s blocks), never downward (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_void.void_sword.lore2: Void Shards [%s] — throws one of 6 orbiting shards: jumps from enemy to enemy and returns, %s damage per hit
item.hha_void.void_mace.lore1: Sky Launch [%s] — the mace hurls you skyward (%ss cooldown)
item.hha_void.void_mace.lore2: Then: shockwave — your next mace hit strikes all enemies within %s blocks at full damage
hha_void.msg.void_rescue: The void swallows you — and spits you out back home
hha_void.msg.escape: Emergency rift — the nothing tore you away!
subtitles.hha_void.whale.death: Star Whale sings one last time
hha_void.boss.name: Oruun
hha_void.boss.line.summon: The Call of the Deep begins to ring. Far below you, in the silence between the stars, something answers.
hha_void.boss.line.awaken: Little light … you wear my silence on your skin. I have come to sing it home.
hha_void.boss.line.idle0: I watched suns go dark before your world had a name.
hha_void.boss.line.idle1: Do you hear it? That is the song that remains when everything else has faded.
hha_void.boss.line.idle2: Every star is only a breath. I have been breathing for ages.
hha_void.boss.line.idle3: You fight the deep. The deep does not fight back. It waits.
hha_void.boss.line.idle4: What you call Void was once my silence.
hha_void.boss.line.idle5: Only what clings to the ground is heavy.
hha_void.boss.line.phase2: You have woken the deep. It is hungry.
hha_void.boss.line.phase3: Then let the light I devoured burn one last time.
hha_void.boss.line.gravity: Feel how heavy your world is.
hha_void.boss.line.debris: Wreckage of old worlds. They still remember falling.
hha_void.boss.line.weightless: Let go. Up here, nothing weighs anything.
hha_void.boss.line.spit: Too bitter. You do not belong to me yet.
hha_void.boss.line.freed: You tear me open … from inside and out. As stars do.
hha_void.boss.line.starlings: My little ones. Bring the light back to me.
hha_void.boss.line.death: My song … becomes a constellation. Look up if you want to hear me.
hha_void.boss.line.death_final: And so silence becomes light again.
hha_void.boss.title.phase2.sub: The arena breaks – he comes from below
hha_void.boss.title.phase3.sub: Wounded and raging – the light bursts out of him
hha_void.boss.title.end.sub: A new constellation shines in the sky
hha_void.boss.msg.beached: Oruun is stranded – his star heart lies open! Run up his fluke onto his back!
hha_void.boss.msg.swallowed: You are inside the whale! Strike to fight your way out.
hha_void.boss.msg.exposed: It can see you! Get behind a monolith!
hha_void.boss.msg.survived: The monolith holds back the light.
hha_void.boss.msg.caught: Oruun's gravity drags you back onto the platform.
hha_void.boss.msg.placed: The Star Deep stands. Oruun awakens as soon as someone stands before the Call of the Deep.
hha_void.boss.msg.rearmed: You retune the Call of the Deep. It begins to ring.
hha_void.boss.book.page1:
THE SONG OF THE STAR WHALE

Before the first light there was the deep, and in the deep a song.
hha_void.boss.book.page2:
Oruun swims between the stars. It devours the light of dead suns, and what it leaves behind is silence.

From that silence comes Void.
hha_void.boss.book.page3: Whoever wears Void wears a piece of its silence. That is why it calls. That is why it comes when the Call of the Deep rings.
hha_void.boss.book.page4: It does not hate. A whale does not hate the sea. It only sings, and everything heavy sinks.
hha_void.boss.book.page5:
Whoever reads this has ended its song.

Look up at night. There is a constellation there now that was not there before.

— Oruun
hha_void.cut.intro0: The stars above the deep begin to sing …
hha_void.cut.intro1: Something ancient swims through the rift.
hha_void.cut.intro2: Little light … I have come to sing my silence home.
hha_void.cut.phase3: Then let the light inside me burn one last time.
hha_void.cut.death1: Look up if you want to hear me.
hha_void.boss.line.ram: Out of my way, little lights.
hha_void.boss.line.maelstrom: Everything returns to the deep. You too.
hha_void.boss.line.breach: Beneath you there is nothing but me.
hha_void.boss.line.geyser: The sea between the stars is rising.
hha_void.boss.line.flood: The flood of the void knows no shore.
hha_void.boss.line.shake0: You cling to me like barnacles.
hha_void.boss.line.devour: Enough singing. Come into me – all of you.
hha_void.boss.line.belly_core: You … tear the stars out of me …
hha_void.boss.line.vomit: Too bitter. You are too bitter for me.
hha_void.boss.title.belly: IN THE BELLY OF THE LEVIATHAN
hha_void.boss.title.belly.sub: Fight your way through his whole body – to the heart
hha_void.boss.msg.ram: He is building up speed – get out of the glowing lane!
hha_void.boss.msg.breach: The ground shakes – away from the glowing circle!
hha_void.boss.msg.flood: Flood wave! Get into a cyan lane or up high!
hha_void.boss.msg.roll: He is rolling – jump off or you fly!
hha_void.boss.msg.sweep: The fluke sweeps across his back – jump!
hha_void.boss.msg.cores: Star cores destroyed: %s / %s – tear your way out!
hha_void.boss.msg.acid: The acid is rising! Get onto the flesh mounds!
hha_void.cut.phase2b: Beneath you there is nothing but me.
hha_void.cut.devour1: Come into me. All of you.
hha_void.cut.belly0: Darkness. Warmth. A heartbeat as loud as a thunderstorm.
hha_void.cut.belly1: Gullet, stomach, guts, lung – all the way to his heart. Fight your way through!
hha_void.boss.msg.heart_shielded: The star heart is shielded – destroy the heart valves first!
hha_void.boss.msg.heart_open: The last valve tears – the star heart lies bare!
hha_void.boss.msg.harpoon_bounce: The harpoon glances off – he is tearing free.
hha_void.boss.msg.breath: Star breath! Get off the glowing path – or behind cover!
hha_void.boss.msg.eruption: The platform glows – leave the bright fields or climb up!
hha_void.boss.msg.lowpass: He skims low over the platform – attack!
hha_void.boss.msg.tired: Oruun is exhausted and sinks low – strike now!
hha_void.boss.msg.spent: The supernova burned him out – he sinks to the ground!
hha_void.boss.msg.belly_pulled: The leviathan swallows – you are dragged along!
hha_void.boss.msg.belly_exhale: He breathes out – the draft carries you upward!
hha_void.boss.belly.s4: Heart chamber: valves and star heart
hha_void.boss.title.belly_s1.sub: Destroy the stomach cores before the acid rises
hha_void.boss.title.belly_s2.sub: Find the ganglia in the side pockets
hha_void.boss.title.belly_s4.sub: Tear out the valves – then the heart
hha_void.boss.title.pinned.sub: The harpoons hold him down – now!
